prompt: Tight frontal portrait of [Subject], face filling most of the frame, direct gaze, clean pale or white background. Predominantly monochrome black-and-white rendering with high editorial contrast, fine photographic texture, and ultra-detailed skin, hair, and material surfaces. One side of the portrait is interrupted by a sharp vertical rupture or glitch seam, revealing vivid fluorescent liquid color, acid magenta, cyan, electric green, orange, and violet, flowing like molten holographic marbling. One eye glows intensely with concentric neon rings. Geometric glyphs, nested square motifs, pixel fragments, and subtle biomechanical textures spread across the forehead, temple, cheek, and neck. Cyber-organic surrealism, sleek but unsettling, asymmetrical interference within an otherwise balanced composition.
